content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for MGKVP Recruitment 2026?
MGKVP Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointed Guest Teachers and Subject Experts are engaged for the academic session 2024-25 to carry out academic work in courses run at the main campus of the university, comprising: Teaching work (अध्यापन कार्य) Practical work (प्रायोगिक कार्य) Studio work (स्टूडियो कार्य) Computer lab work (कम्प्यूटर लैब कार्य)
